name: cold-start
title: a fresh session started from the mission summary alone answers the five questions
label: v4 AC-78 (cold start)
description: Missions v4 S-33, AC-78. A half-done v4 mission is seeded: a goal, a blocked step (on a named thing), a step that waits for review, a decision in the Log, and a next step. The HARNESS (not a model) reads the summary Harnu serves for it, `mission_get`'s `summary`, through the real transport as the leader, and starts a fresh session whose prompt holds that text and nothing else: the `cold` role has no tool, no Harnu server and no memory. The session answers five numbered questions (the goal, the next step, what is blocked and on what, what waits for review, what was decided). The grade reads `.eval/turn-cold.txt` line by line, each answer against the words only the right part of the summary holds (and not the words of the others), so one line repeated five times does not pass. The summary's own content is proved offline (`tests/mission-v4-eval-scenarios.test.ts`): each answer sits in its own part of it.

4. What waits for review?
5. What was decided?
